data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for creating a centered pin that animates with map movement for location selection.
data.what_it_does: It wraps a map widget and overlays a centered pin icon that can be animated with map movement. It provides a controller to notify when the map starts or stops moving, allowing developers to retrieve coordinates and reverse-geocode addresses.
use_when: You need users to select a geographic location by panning and zooming a map.
You want a centered pin overlay that responds to map movement.
avoid_when: You do not need map-based location picking.
You prefer an alternative mapping library that already includes built-in pin selection functionality.
strengths: Vendor-free map library that can work with different map widgets passed as children.
Includes a custom MapPickerController for handling movement states.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and attributes beyond basic setup.
Relies entirely on external map packages like google_maps_flutter for actual map rendering.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the package to pubspec.yaml and configuring underlying map packages like google_maps_flutter.
data.minimal_example:
MapPicker(
  iconWidget: SvgPicture.asset("assets/location_icon.svg", height: 60),
  mapPickerController: mapPickerController,
  child: GoogleMap(
    initialCameraPosition: cameraPosition,
    onMapCreated: (GoogleMapController controller) {},
  ),
)
